WITH lung AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (443388,258369)
  UNION SELECT 443388 UNION SELECT 258369
),
chemo_ingredients AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    (1397599,'Platinum'),              -- cisplatin
    (1344905,'Platinum'),              -- carboplatin
    (1378382,'Taxane'),                -- paclitaxel
    (1315942,'Taxane'),                -- docetaxel
    (1304919,'Antimetabolite'),        -- pemetrexed
    (1314924,'Antimetabolite'),        -- gemcitabine
    (1350504,'Topoisomerase inhibitor'), -- etoposide
    (1367268,'Topoisomerase inhibitor'), -- irinotecan
    (1378509,'Topoisomerase inhibitor'), -- topotecan
    (1343346,'Vinca alkaloid')         -- vinorelbine
  ) x(ingredient_concept_id, class_name)
),
chemo_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, ci.class_name
  FROM chemo_ingredients ci
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ci.ingredient_concept_id
),
lung_pts AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS lung_dx_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM lung)
  GROUP BY person_id
),
class_index AS (
  SELECT CAST(de.person_id AS int) AS person_id, cd.class_name,
         MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN chemo_drugs cd ON cd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  JOIN lung_pts lp ON lp.person_id = CAST(de.person_id AS int)
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, lp.lung_dx_date)
  GROUP BY CAST(de.person_id AS int), cd.class_name
),
neuro AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 4024301
  UNION SELECT 4024301
),
cardio AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 3655437
  UNION SELECT 3655437
),
outcomes AS (
  SELECT ci.person_id, ci.class_name,
         MAX(CASE WHEN co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM neuro) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neurotox_12mo,
         MAX(CASE WHEN co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cardio) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cardiotox_12mo
  FROM class_index ci
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id = ci.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date >= ci.index_date
   AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 366, ci.index_date)
   AND (co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM neuro)
        OR co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM cardio))
  GROUP BY ci.person_id, ci.class_name
)
SELECT class_name AS treatment_class,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       SUM(neurotox_12mo) AS neurotoxicity_events,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(neurotox_12mo) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS neurotoxicity_rate_pct,
       SUM(cardiotox_12mo) AS cardiotoxicity_events,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(cardiotox_12mo) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS cardiotoxicity_rate_pct
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY class_name
ORDER BY class_name;

    (1315942,'Taxane'),
    (1304919,'Antimetabolite'),

    (1367268,'Topoisomerase inhibitor'),
    (1378509,'Topoisomerase inhibitor'),
    (1343346,'Vinca alkaloid')
  ) x(ingredient_concept_id, class_name)
),
chemo_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id, ci.class_name
  FROM chemo_ingredients ci
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ci.ingredient_concept_id
),
lung_pts AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(condition_start_date) AS lung_dx_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM lung)
  GROUP BY person_id
),
class_index AS (
  SELECT CAST(de.person_id AS int) AS person_id, cd.class_name,
         MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN chemo_drugs cd ON cd.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  JOIN lung_pts lp ON lp.person_id = CAST(de.person_id AS int)
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, lp.lung_dx_date)
  GROUP BY CAST(de.person_id AS int), cd.class_name
),
outcome_concepts AS (
  SELECT 'neurotoxicity' AS outcome, descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 4024301
  UNION SELECT 'neurotoxicity', 4024301
  UNION SELECT 'cardiotoxicity', descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 3655437
  UNION SELECT 'cardiotoxicity', 3655437
),
patient_outcomes AS (
  SELECT ci.person_id, ci.class_name,
         MAX(CASE WHEN oc.outcome = 'neurotoxicity' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neurotox_12mo,
         MAX(CASE WHEN oc.outcome = 'cardiotoxicity' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cardiotox_12mo
  FROM class_index ci
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id = ci.person_id
   AND co.condition_start_date >= ci.index_date
   AND co.condition_start_date < DATEADD(day, 366, ci.index_date)
  LEFT JOIN outcome_concepts oc ON oc.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  GROUP BY ci.person_id, ci.class_name
)
SELECT class_name AS treatment_class,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       SUM(neurotox_12mo) AS neurotoxicity_events,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(neurotox_12mo) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS neurotoxicity_rate_pct,
       SUM(cardiotox_12mo) AS cardiotoxicity_events,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(cardiotox_12mo) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS decimal(6,2)) AS cardiotoxicity_rate_pct
FROM patient_outcomes
GROUP BY class_name
ORDER BY class_name;
